rows: Cool the boiler, remove the sheet metal and remove the thermal insulation in an area away from the heat (the places where work is required).
Remove the insulation around the inlet and outlet headers of the final superheater.
When draining the boiler of water, cut the two insulation boxes of the inlet and outlet headers of the final superheater and remove the wool and refractory concrete around the Welding joint.
Make a special Lock for the Tension holding spring, for safety reasons, since when the coils are cut the weight will decrease, which affects the Holding spring.
Remove the refractory bricks from the superheater floor, as well as the cut part of the furnace floor curtains (combustion chamber).
Cut whatever obstructs the passage of the coils when they are taken out after cutting (tubes from the combustion chamber curtains — cut two tubes from the boiler filling tubes, 2.5 m long).
Prepare the special connection for lowering the coils (superheater coils) from the boiler safely, avoiding any damage to the boiler.
Cut the superheater coils from the inlet and outlet headers at the designated place.
Lower the coils and remove them from the boiler.

Prepare the cutting places by Grinding before starting welding at the inlet and outlet headers; at the same time, prepare the new coils for welding after taking the lengths and adjusting the clearances.
Meanwhile, the tubes of the final superheater floor that sagged during operation were straightened.

Lift the new coils with the special rigging, taking care to place the coil in the correct direction and measure the clearance between the superheater roof and floor so that welding is done as well as possible.

When installing the coils, installation must start from both sides of the boiler, reaching coil No. 22 from the southern side; the place of the coil is fitted with a special rigging so that it is the last coil to be installed.

Introduction
This document outlines the steps for replacing the secondary superheater coils of Unit No. (1).
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Wael Abdel Razek Sayed, tested by Eng. Romany Naguib, accepted by Eng. Mostafa Zahran, and approved by Eng. Hussein Ahmed Ahmed, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at Assiut Steam.
Safety Precautions
Isolate the boiler whose vertical superheater coils are to be replaced.
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; the maintenance team must hold an industrial safety category card.
Record the names of the workers on the work order and their industrial safety categories.
Define the work area of the equipment and place warning signs indicating that work is being carried out.
Wear the industrial safety and protection tools required for the workers while carrying out the work, such as helmet, gloves, masks and protective shoes.
Take all safety precautions when erecting the necessary scaffolds.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Complete set of open-end wrenches and complete set of ring wrenches — set of chisels and hammers.
Special tool for lowering and raising the coils.
Chain block 1 
 ton and also chain block 2 tons with lifting wires
Cutting torches — cutting discs — welding machines — argon cylinders, oxygen and acetylene cylinders, and welding wire.
Electric connection panels for the welding machines — electric floodlights.

Cool the boiler, remove the sheet metal and remove the thermal insulation in an area away from the heat (the places where work is required). | 1.
Remove the insulation around the inlet and outlet headers of the final superheater. | 2.
When draining the boiler of water, cut the two insulation boxes of the inlet and outlet headers of the final superheater and remove the wool and refractory concrete around the Welding joint. | 3.
Make a special Lock for the Tension holding spring, for safety reasons, since when the coils are cut the weight will decrease, which affects the Holding spring. | 4.
Remove the refractory bricks from the superheater floor, as well as the cut part of the furnace floor curtains (combustion chamber). | 5.
Cut whatever obstructs the passage of the coils when they are taken out after cutting (tubes from the combustion chamber curtains — cut two tubes from the boiler filling tubes, 2.5 m long). | 6.
Prepare the special connection for lowering the coils (superheater coils) from the boiler safely, avoiding any damage to the boiler. | 7.
Cut the superheater coils from the inlet and outlet headers at the designated place. | 8.
Lower the coils and remove them from the boiler. | 9.
Prepare the cutting places by Grinding before starting welding at the inlet and outlet headers; at the same time, prepare the new coils for welding after taking the lengths and adjusting the clearances. | 10
Meanwhile, the tubes of the final superheater floor that sagged during operation were straightened. | 11.
Lift the new coils with the special rigging, taking care to place the coil in the correct direction and measure the clearance between the superheater roof and floor so that welding is done as well as possible. | 12.
When installing the coils, installation must start from both sides of the boiler, reaching coil No. 22 from the southern side; the place of the coil is fitted with a special rigging so that it is the last coil to be installed. | 13.

uncertain_terms.note: DOC-NUMBER MISMATCH: the source doc_number is BLR-005-R0 while the file/title say blr-005-r0a; the doc_number was copied verbatim and not 'fixed'.
